name: Providence to Los Angeles
elevationProvider: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles, zoom 12, bilinear DEM samples
authoredConditions: Weather, time of day, road width, surface and bumps are fictional gameplay conditions. Incomplete terrain surveys are filled with editable terrain derived from road heights. Per-race source metadata records elevation gaps and fallback methods.
structure: Local scenic road stages across three westbound branches, with shared Providence and LA map junctions; not a continuous drive across the connecting highways.
roadComfort: 45 m elevation smoothing radius; authored bumps reduced by 80 percent; 8 m flat terrain join, minimum 32 m blended transition, maximum cut/fill slope 0.22. GPS turns and raw DEM samples are retained. Reapply to installed tracks with node tools/campaigns/smooth_america.mjs.

paceNotes.method: Virtual recce of road-wheel steering, integrated heading, a braking envelope and power-limited acceleration. Checks inside-apex doodads for do-not-cut hazards. Numeric severity thresholds are game-specific calibration; not proprietary WRC Generations values.

racingLine.method: Bounded minimum-curvature path optimization with vehicle and roadside-object clearance; backward braking speed envelope on actual path curvature; shared by guide and AI.
